contradicting_evidence: Contracting stablecoin supply, severe short-window breadth weakness and negative ETH settled flows could produce a more persistent decline than the mixed forecast implies.
Positive BTC settled flows, selective ETH buying and the latest price stabilization could instead develop into a sustained recovery.
The 90d alt snapshot remains positive in absolute terms, despite median underperformance versus BTC; this cautions against interpreting recent weakness as a confirmed longer-cycle contraction.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Stabilization attempts alternating with renewed tests of weakness are more defensible than a clean directional trend. BTC-specific demand may cushion BTC without repairing ETH or broader participation. The week-end net direction remains unresolved, with downside risk unless recovery broadens and persists.
falsification_conditions: A sustained BTC and ETH advance with improving ETH/BTC, persistent broader participation and better settled ETH flows would replace the mixed downside-sensitive path with a recovery interpretation.
Persistent coordinated declines, failed rebounds and continued participation weakness would replace the mixed path with a clearer downside outlook.
Repeated stabilization accompanied by fading selling and broader participation, even without a strong advance, would weaken the downside-sensitive component.
missing_evidence: No subsequent week of settled flows, fresh liquidity observations or repeated breadth measurements is available.
No demonstrated sequence links BTC resilience to ETH leadership and then broader alt participation.
Catalyst discovery is degraded, limiting visibility into events that could dominate a seven-day path.
Unavailable microcap coverage prevents a comprehensive claim about speculative participation.
supporting_evidence: Current weak participation and ETH outflows coexist with positive BTC settled flows, supporting divergent recovery and retest possibilities rather than a uniform market path.
Stablecoin supply contraction across 1d, 7d and 30d windows limits evidence for a durable liquidity-supported recovery; deployment confirmation is not established.
The 30d altseason snapshot shows only 13 of 49 constituents outperforming BTC and a negative median alt return, indicating weak recent rotation.
The latest hourly stabilization is insufficient to confirm recovery, while the supplied evidence also lacks an established sequence of continuing breakdowns.
